title: Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan — Failed-Delivery History and Instant Transfers
content:
On the Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan, the push-failure share multiplies the instant transfer amount to an external debit card:

- by **one half** when a transfer return with the reason delivery failed was booked on the plan in the last three months;
- by **three quarters** when one was booked in the last six months but none in the last three;
- **in full** otherwise.

Returns with other reasons do not enter; the date read is the date the return was booked. A record falls in the last N months when fewer than N whole months separate its date from today, whole months being the difference in calendar months less one when today's day of the month is smaller than that date's.

| Latest failed-delivery return booked | Share |
|---|---|
| in the last three months | one half |
| in the last six months, not the last three | three quarters |
| none in the last six months | in full |

*Hypothetical:* with today 9 November, a failed-delivery return booked on 10 August (two whole months back) gives one half; one booked on 9 August and none later, three quarters; one booked on 9 May and none later, in full.
